error.bootstrap: Could not read the app information. Restart the app.
frame.step.system.purpose: Set the speakers, the output wiring, the DSP to export to and the measurement arrangement.
frame.step.connect.purpose: Choose how to measure, then check that every channel reaches the mic at −30…−15 dBFS.
frame.step.measure.purpose: Measure every channel at each position, or import REW mdat files.
frame.step.calibrate.purpose: Computes levels, delays, EQ, crossovers and sub alignment, and compares before and after.
frame.step.export.purpose: Writes the correction as a CamillaDSP configuration and REW mdat files.
frame.blocked.no_speakers: There are no speakers. Choose a setup in System.
frame.blocked.config_invalid: Problems in the setup: {count}. Check them in System.
frame.blocked.no_path: No measurement method is chosen. Choose one in Connect & check.
frame.blocked.no_measurements: No position is measured. Measure or import mdat files in Measure & import.
frame.blocked.measuring: A measurement is running. You can compute once it ends or is cancelled.
frame.blocked.no_result: There is no correction yet. Compute it in Correction.
frame.blocked.computing: The correction is being computed. You can export when it ends.
frame.settings.expert.hint: Engine tuning values and the ultra-latency mode appear in the settings.
frame.placeholder.title: No screen for this step
frame.placeholder.body: This build has no screen for this step yet. You can measure, correct and export with secs2r-cli.
frame.unavailable: This build does not have this command yet.
jobs.log.measurement_low_snr: {code} signal-to-noise ratio {snr_db} dB is below {threshold_db} dB. Reduce the noise in the room or raise the level, then measure again.
jobs.log.mdat_duplicate_roles: More than one measurement is assigned to a channel. Keep one per channel.
jobs.log.mdat_nothing_selected: Nothing is selected to import. Choose at least one measurement.
error.invalid_request: The request could not be handled.
error.invalid_request.next: Restart the app. If it happens again, report it with the text under Details.
error.internal.next: Try again. If it happens again, report it with the text under Details.
error.not_implemented: This build does not have this feature yet.
error.not_implemented.next: Update to a newer build and try again.
error.project_io: The project file could not be read or written.
error.project_io.next: Check the file's location and write permission, then try again.
error.job_busy: A job of the same kind is already running.
error.job_busy.next: Start again once the running job ends or is cancelled.
error.job_not_found.next: See its result in the job history.
error.engine_input: The measurements do not fit the correction.
error.engine_input.next: Check the measured positions and channels, then compute again.
error.export_failed: The export files could not be written.
error.export_failed.next: Check the export folder's location and write permission.
error.stale_inputs: The settings or measurements changed, so the result no longer matches them.
error.device_unavailable: The audio device could not be opened.
error.device_unavailable.next: Check the device connection, close other apps using it, then try again.
error.share_mode_refused: The device refused the chosen sharing mode.
error.share_mode_refused.next: Set the sharing mode to Automatic in Connect & check.
error.rew_unreachable.next: Start REW in API mode, then try again.
error.rew_pro_required.next: Activate REW Pro or switch to built-in measurement.
error.rew_failed: REW could not handle the request.
error.rew_failed.next: Check the error in the REW window, then try again.
error.measurement_input: The measurement input does not fit.
error.measurement_input.next: Check the mic input channel and the output channels.
error.confirm_required: This change clears measurements and needs confirmation.
error.confirm_required.next: Review the change and apply it again.
plot.measurement.title: Measured responses
plot.axes.title: Axis range
plot.axes.tooltip: Sets the graph's frequency and level range.
plot.axes.tooltip_custom: A range you set. Auto returns to the graph's own range.
plot.axes.error_frequency: The lower frequency must be below the upper one.
plot.axes.error_level: The lower level must be below the upper one.

plot.xo.label: Crossover
map.room.label: Speaker map, speakers: {count}
map.arrangement.label: Measurement map, positions: {count}
map.arrangement.title: Measurement positions
gallery.sample.clear_body: Every channel measured at this position is cleared. You can undo it from the notification.
gallery.sample.mode.hint: More allowed delay corrects more of the bass timing.
gallery.sample.output.error: Outputs on the device: {max}. Choose one of 1–{max}.
gallery.sample.table.empty_hint: Choose a preset or add a speaker.
gallery.sample.empty.title: No measurements
gallery.sample.empty.body: Measure every channel at each position, or import REW mdat files.
gallery.sample.tooltip.long: XO PEQ adds PEQ near the crossover so the main and sub sum follows the target. Off, only the crossover filters apply.
calibrate.verdict.title: Verdict
calibrate.verdict.plan: Compute correction uses the responses of the {count} measured positions to set EQ, delay and level for every channel.
calibrate.verdict.plan.no_measurements: There are no measured positions to compute from. Measure or import an mdat file in Measure and import.
calibrate.verdict.plan.sub: It also sets the crossover to the subwoofer.
calibrate.verdict.plan.subs: It also sets the crossover and aligns the {count} subwoofers.
calibrate.verdict.plan.xo_first: There is no crossover recommendation yet, so it is computed first. The first run takes longer.
calibrate.stale.settings: The settings changed after this result was computed.
calibrate.stale.target: The target curve changed after this result was computed.
calibrate.stale.measurements: The measurements changed after this result was computed.
calibrate.stale.unknown: Settings or measurements changed, so the result no longer matches them.
calibrate.stale.next: Compute the correction again to update the result.
calibrate.score.title: Scorecard
calibrate.score.caption: Before and after for each channel. Pick a row to show that channel in the graph.
calibrate.graph.label: Correction graph
calibrate.graph.xo_line: {group} crossover {hz} Hz. The curves follow while you drag the line; releasing it stores the value.
calibrate.legend.label: Legend
calibrate.plot.preview: Before computing: the listening position (position 1) and the target only. Levels are relative to the target.
calibrate.plot.preview.none: Position 1 has no measurement, so there is nothing to preview.
calibrate.plot.pending.gd: The group delay before and after appears once the correction is computed.
calibrate.plot.pending.xo: The main, sub and sum curves appear once the correction is computed.
calibrate.plot.pending.ba: Each sub's curves before and after alignment appear once the correction is computed.
calibrate.ba.layout_line.dba: Group {bundle} DBA: front {front}, rear {rear} inverted {rear_ms} ms (automatic {auto_ms}, trim {trim_ms}), shared filters PEQ {peq}
calibrate.ba.layout_line.dba_manual: Group {bundle} DBA: front {front}, rear {rear} inverted {rear_ms} ms (trim {trim_ms}), shared filters PEQ {peq}
calibrate.settings.title: Correction settings
calibrate.settings.description: Settings are saved at once and reach the result the next time you compute the correction.
calibrate.mode.title: Mode
calibrate.mode.description: Sets the filter types and the total delay. Changes the result of every channel.
calibrate.mode.zero.effect: No filter delay. Corrects level and room modes, leaves the phase as it is.
calibrate.mode.mixed.effect: Straightens the bass phase, mostly at the crossover, within 10 ms. The default.
calibrate.mode.linear.effect: Straightens the phase of the sub roll-off and the room as well, within 30 ms.
calibrate.mode.ultra.effect: Uses FIRs of up to 16,384 taps within the delay limit to straighten the phase. The delay is long: 30–200 ms.
calibrate.mode.ultra_ms.label: Delay limit
calibrate.mode.spec.iir: RC IIR only · MIMO {mimo} · filter delay {ms} ms
calibrate.mode.spec.fir: RC IIR + FIR {taps} taps · MIMO {mimo} · delay up to {ms} ms
calibrate.range.title: Correction range
calibrate.range.description: The frequency range the EQ works in. Changes the SPL and GD results.
calibrate.range.upper_auto.hint: Uses the room's Schroeder frequency as the upper limit (at most 500 Hz). Turn it off to set the limit yourself.
calibrate.range.volume.hint: Sets the automatic upper limit. 0 means none.
calibrate.range.dims.hint: All three set the room volume.
calibrate.range.boost.hint: The most that RC, the XO PEQ and the sub bus PEQ may raise. Lower it when the amplifiers or drivers have little headroom.
calibrate.xo.title: Crossover (XO)
calibrate.xo.description: Where the mains hand over to the subs. Changes the XO result.
calibrate.xo.none: There are no subwoofers, so there is no crossover.
calibrate.xo.peq.hint: Adds PEQ around the crossover so the sum of mains and subs follows the target.
calibrate.ba.title: Sub alignment (BA)
calibrate.ba.description: Matches gain, delay and polarity of every sub. Changes the BA result.
calibrate.ba.none: Subs are aligned when there are two or more. This setup has {count}.
calibrate.ba.mode.label: {code} mode
calibrate.ba.actions.hint: Compute subs only recomputes the BA result alone. Copy result values puts the last result's gain, delay, polarity and all-pass into each sub's fields.
calibrate.ba.actions.hint_no_result: Compute subs only recomputes the BA result alone. Copy result values needs a correction result.
calibrate.ba.infra.hint: Pick the sub that plays only the lowest band: it gets a low-pass, the other subs a high-pass at the same frequency.
calibrate.ba.infra.note: {infra}: below {hz} Hz only · {others}: above {hz} Hz only
calibrate.ba.rear_trim.hint: Added to the automatic rear-row delay.
calibrate.ba.values.auto: Automatic: the computation sets the values. Copy result values fills the fields, then you can switch to fixed.
calibrate.ba.values.layout: In DBA and multi-sub groups the computation sets the values.
calibrate.ba.fixed.hint: Applied to this sub's output in every mode.
calibrate.ba.mimo_support.hint: When off, MIMO does not use this sub as a support.
calibrate.ba.main_delay.hint: Added to the main outputs while a sub is fixed.
calibrate.mimo.title: MIMO
calibrate.mimo.description: Adds other speakers as supports to reduce bass ringing. Adds the With MIMO curve to the SPL tab.
calibrate.mimo.on.hint: After turning it on, compute MIMO to add it to the result.
calibrate.mimo.unavailable: {count} positions measured. MIMO needs {min} or more.
calibrate.mimo.fsiso.hint: Supports work below this frequency only.
calibrate.mimo.needs_result: MIMO needs a correction result. Compute the correction first.
calibrate.mimo.state.stale: Settings or the correction changed after MIMO was computed. Compute MIMO again.
calibrate.mimo.state.budget: FIR supports {taps} taps, within the export DSP's FIR budget of {budget} taps
calibrate.mimo.state.budget_over: FIR supports {taps} taps, over the export DSP's FIR budget of {budget} taps
calibrate.mimo.low_auto.hint: Finds the support band of every speaker.
calibrate.mimo.max.hint: 0 means no limit. Lower it when the export DSP's delay matrix runs short.
calibrate.mimo.fir.hint: Off: IIR (9 PEQ, 3 all-pass). On: an 8,000-tap FIR per support, which uses the export DSP's FIR budget.
notice.rc_limit.manual: RC upper limit {hz} Hz (set by hand)
notice.rc_limit.schroeder: RC upper limit {hz} Hz (automatic, Schroeder frequency {schroeder_hz} Hz)
notice.rc_room_volume: The automatic upper limit is the Schroeder frequency of a {volume_m3} m³ room.
notice.rc_no_room_volume: Without a room volume the automatic upper limit is 500 Hz. Enter the room size to use the Schroeder frequency.
notice.rc_auto_cap: The automatic upper limit is at most {hz} Hz.
notice.sub_narrow_band: {code}: HP {hp_hz} Hz, LP {lp_hz} Hz. Almost no pass band is left. Change the HP or the LP.
notice.sub_high_gain: {code} gain {gain_db} dB is too high. Check the sub filters (HP, LP).
notice.lift_capped: Phase correction headroom reduced from {from_ms} ms to {lift_ms} ms to fit {taps} FIR taps.
notice.latency: Total delay {latency_ms} ms: phase correction {lift_ms} ms, extra main delay {main_extra_ms} ms
notice.long_mode_boost: Boost limited to {cap_db} dB at {count} long-ringing room modes ({modes}).
notice.gd_cuts: {code}: {count} cuts added to reduce group delay peaks.
notice.ba_manual: Sub alignment used values set by hand.
notice.layout_fallback: Group {value} has no front or rear DBA row, so it was computed as a multi-sub group.
notice.two_way: Two-way subs ({roles}): low sub gain {gain_db} dB, crossover {xo_hz} Hz
notice.bus_gain_anchored: Sub bus level matched to the mains ({value} dB).
